data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'orellein' meaning 'to carry a mountain'. This name is derived from the mythological nymphs of Greek mythology who resided on mountains and protected their forests. Orelle represents strength, endurance, and a deep connection to nature. The name Orelle carries the meaning “Mountain maiden” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Orelle usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain maiden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
